body_text:
Extreme value theorem. If $f:[a,b]\to\mathbb{R}$ is continuous,
then $f$ is bounded and attains both a maximum and a minimum on
$[a,b]$. Boundedness of the domain alone is insufficient; the
interval must also be closed, and the function must be continuous.
